# vktSpvAsmTypeTests

## Overview

Tests SPIR-V integer type operations across 8-, 16-, 32-, and 64-bit signed and unsigned integer types, with scalar and generated vector-width groups ([type group creation](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4278-L4310), [operation generation](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4313-L4428)). The file covers arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, shift, bit-field, constant, and combined multiply/divide operations through the templated `SpvAsmTypeTests<T>` framework ([template class](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L920-L975)).

## Role

Registration file and implementation file. Creates the `type` group with `scalar` and vector-width subgroups, and defines all test cases inline through a templated `SpvAsmTypeTests<T>` class hierarchy ([registration](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4278-L4455)).

## Source

- [vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4278)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
spirv_assembly.type
├── scalar
├── vec1 (non-VulkanSC only)
├── vec2
├── vec3
├── vec4
├── vec8 (non-VulkanSC only)
└── vec12 (non-VulkanSC only)
```

## Test Families

### scalar — Scalar integer type operations

Contains eight per-type subgroups (`i8`, `i16`, `i32`, `i64`, `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64`) at scalar width, added after the operation macros populate each type-specific group ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4430-L4439)).

### vec1 through vec12 — Vector integer type operations

Each vector-width subgroup receives the same eight signedness/width subgroups as scalar ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4441-L4453)). The vector-size list includes scalar, `vec2`, `vec3`, `vec4`, `vec8`, `vec12`, and `vec1`, with source comments noting `OpTypeVectorIdEXT` use for `vec12` and the generated type path also using `OpTypeVectorIdEXT` for `vec1`/`vec12` cases ([vector-size definition](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L88-L94), [count comment](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4038-L4040), [generation](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L1891-L1905)).

### Per-type test operations

Within each type subgroup, operations are generated by the `MAKE_TEST_SV_I_*`, `MAKE_TEST_SV_U_*`, `MAKE_TEST_S_*`, and `MAKE_TEST_V_*` macro calls in `createTypeTests()` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4313-L4428)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Signedness | signed, unsigned | Registered by the `i*` and `u*` type subgroups ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4430-L4453)) |
| Bit width | 8, 16, 32, 64 | Constructors define `i8`/`u8`, `i16`/`u16`, `i32`/`u32`, and `i64`/`u64` groups ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2905-L3220)) |
| Vector size | scalar, vec1, vec2, vec3, vec4, vec8, vec12 | Derived from the vector-size enum and generated subgroup names ([enum](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L88-L94), [names](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4293-L4298)) |
| Input range | `RANGE_FULL`, `RANGE_BIT_WIDTH`, `RANGE_BIT_WIDTH_SUM` | Passed by operation macro calls ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4313-L4428)) |
| Input width | `WIDTH_DEFAULT` and bit-field postfix-derived widths | `createTests()` stores an `InputWidth` per generated operation ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L944-L975)) |
| Filter | `FILTER_NONE`, `FILTER_ZERO`, `FILTER_SIGNED_DIV`, `FILTER_NEGATIVES_AND_ZERO`, `FILTER_MIN_GT_MAX` | Filters exclude division by zero, signed division overflow, negative/zero combinations, and invalid clamp bounds ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2822-L2855), [macro mapping](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L3971-L4011)) |

## Support / Feature Requirements

| Requirement | Types Affected |
|-------------|----------------|
| `shaderInt8` plus 8-bit storage feature requests | 8-bit type tests request `extFloat16Int8.shaderInt8` and 8-bit storage access when the input type is `TYPE_I8` or `TYPE_U8` ([compute path](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L1853-L1860), [graphics path](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2685-L2690)) |
| `shaderInt16` | i16/u16 constructors pass `shaderInt16` as the required device feature ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2950-L2951), [source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L3129-L3130)) |
| `shaderInt64` | i64/u64 constructors pass `shaderInt64` as the required device feature ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L3040-L3041), [source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L3217-L3218)) |
| `OpTypeVectorIdEXT` path | `vec1` and `vec12` generation uses `OpTypeVectorIdEXT` in the long-vector path ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L1891-L1905)) |

## Verification Methods

- **Compute shader comparison**: generated expected-output resources are compared element-by-element against the output allocation by `SpvAsmTypeTests<T>::verifyResult()`; mismatches log input values, expected values, and obtained values ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2031-L2077)).
- **Input filtering**: filters exclude problematic input combinations such as division by zero, signed division overflow, negative/zero divisor cases, and invalid min/max bounds ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2822-L2855)).
- **Dataset size**: `TEST_DATASET_SIZE` is 10 for scalar bases, while vector tests use `TEST_DATASET_SIZE_VEC(vecSize)` with a cap-like expression for larger vector sizes ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L48-L49)).

## Notes

- The test framework uses the template class `SpvAsmTypeTests<T>` and concrete classes for `int8_t`, `uint8_t`, `int16_t`, `uint16_t`, `int32_t`, `uint32_t`, `int64_t`, and `uint64_t` ([template](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L920-L975), [concrete classes](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L2895-L3220)).
- The macro system generates the operation set before subgroups are attached to `scalar` and vector-width groups ([operation macros](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4313-L4428), [attachment](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4430-L4453)).
- VulkanSC uses a reduced bit-field macro path inside the `#else` branch, while the non-VulkanSC path uses the broader `8136` macro set ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmTypeTests.cpp#L4379-L4413)).
